description: 昼間の港の広場を描いた場面である。画面中央には赤い格子状の高い展望タワーが立ち、周囲の建物よりも大きく目立っている。左側には大きな屋根のあるイベントスペースと大型スクリーンがあり、手前には広い舗装された広場が広がっている。右側には低層の施設、街路樹、白い街灯が並び、さらに奥には緑の山が見える。空には厚い雲が広がっているが、一部には青空も見える。2人の生徒が広場を歩いており、一人は中央の高いタワーを見上げ、もう一人は左側のイベントスペースを指さしている。高い建物、広い広場、空、山、イベント施設の位置関係を英語で説明する練習に適した場面である。
imagePrompt: A high-quality detailed educational illustration for an English picture-description speaking test. Base the overall composition closely on the provided reference photograph, but remove all real place names, commercial logos, event names, and identifiable text. Replace any visible signs and screen graphics with original fictional designs, simple icons, or abstract lettering. Do not use proper nouns. The main purpose is townscape and waterfront scenery description practice for children and students. Show a spacious modern harbor plaza in Japan during the daytime under a dramatic partly cloudy sky. In the center-right of the composition, place a very tall red lattice observation tower with a narrow waist and a wider cylindrical observation section near the top. The tower should clearly dominate the skyline and be the main landmark, but it must not contain any real-world name or logo. On the left side, show a large open event structure with a wide pale canopy roof supported by tall white columns. Under the canopy, include a large rectangular digital screen displaying an original abstract event graphic with simple colors and shapes but no recognizable branding or readable proper nouns. In the foreground, show a very broad paved pedestrian plaza made of brown and gray paving stones, with clear open space so learners can easily describe foreground, middle ground, and background. Include metal railings and a gently sloping ramp on the far left. Near the center, place several white decorative street lamps and a row of small trees. On the right side, include low modern waterfront buildings, a covered walkway, planted areas, and several white lamp posts. In the far background, show a low green mountain ridge behind the buildings. Add a few modern mid-rise city buildings behind and beside the tower. The sky should occupy a large part of the upper half of the scene, with thick gray clouds, brighter white clouds, and a few patches of blue sky. Show exactly two visible people and no others anywhere in the image. Keep the two people relatively small so the landscape remains the main focus. Place them in the foreground-right or center foreground. One teenage student should be walking slowly while looking up at the tall red tower. The other teenage student should be pointing toward the large covered event area on the left, as if explaining what can be seen there. Their actions should be simple and easy to describe. Do not include crowds, tourists, staff, cyclists, people on the tower, or reflected people. Preserve the main spatial relationships clearly: broad plaza in front, event canopy and screen on the left, tall red observation tower in the center-right, modern buildings behind it, low waterfront facilities on the right, mountains in the far background, and dramatic clouds above. Exactly two visible people, no more and no less. No animals, no speech bubbles, no recognizable commercial logos, no copyrighted characters, and no proper nouns. Landscape 16:9 composition, polished illustrated style rather than photography, realistic architecture and proportions, visually clear, information-rich but uncluttered, suitable for practicing English descriptions of landmarks, height, position, weather, distance, and urban waterfront scenery.

sentences.ja: 高い赤い展望タワーが水辺の広場の中央で大きく目立っています。

sentences.text: The tower rises much higher than the buildings around it.
sentences.ja: そのタワーは周囲の建物よりずっと高くそびえています。

sentences.text: On the left, a large canopy covers an event space.
sentences.ja: 左側では大きな屋根がイベントスペースを覆っています。

sentences.text: A large digital screen is located beneath the canopy.
sentences.ja: 大きなデジタルスクリーンが屋根の下に設置されています。

sentences.ja: 広場の後ろにはいくつかの現代的な建物や木々が見えます。

sentences.text: The thick clouds and patches of blue sky create a dramatic atmosphere.
sentences.ja: 厚い雲と青空の部分が印象的な雰囲気を作っています。

sentences.text: The striking red observation tower dominates the waterfront skyline and serves as the main visual landmark in the scene.
sentences.ja: 印象的な赤い展望タワーが水辺のスカイラインの中心を占め、この場面の主要なランドマークになっています。

sentences.text: Its narrow lattice structure rises dramatically above the surrounding mid-rise buildings.
sentences.ja: 細い格子状の構造が周囲の中層建築より大きく高くそびえています。

sentences.text: The expansive paved plaza in the foreground emphasizes the scale and height of the tower.
sentences.ja: 前景の広大な舗装広場が、タワーの大きさと高さを強調しています。

sentences.text: To the left, a broad geometric canopy supported by white columns defines a separate event space.
sentences.grammar: 過去分詞による後置修飾
sentences.ja: 左側では、白い柱に支えられた広い幾何学的な屋根が独立したイベント空間を形作っています。

sentences.text: The large digital display beneath the canopy provides a secondary visual focal point without competing with the tower.
sentences.ja: 屋根の下の大型デジタル表示は、タワーの存在感を損なうことなく第二の注目点となっています。

sentences.text: The two students are positioned relatively small in the foreground, which helps convey the impressive scale of the surrounding architecture.
sentences.ja: 前景の2人の生徒が比較的小さく描かれているため、周囲の建築物の大きさがより強調されています。

sentences.text: Modern buildings, white street lamps, trees, and low waterfront facilities frame the plaza on both sides.
sentences.ja: 現代的な建物、白い街灯、木々、低層の水辺施設が広場の両側を構成しています。

sentences.text: The distant mountain ridge provides a natural backdrop that contrasts with the highly engineered urban structures in the foreground.
sentences.ja: 遠くの山並みは、前景の人工的な都市構造物とは対照的な自然の背景となっています。

sentences.text: The combination of dark clouds, patches of blue sky, open space, and vertical architecture makes the scene particularly useful for describing scale, weather, position, and distance.
sentences.ja: 暗い雲、青空、開けた空間、垂直方向に伸びる建築物の組み合わせにより、この場面は規模、天候、位置、距離を説明する練習に特に適しています。
